visible_text: Change your HealthSafe ID sign in and security settings Mobile App Experience Change your HealthSafe ID sign in and security settings Follow these steps to change your password, email, or security settings. 1. Open UHC app Open your UHC app. Tap your initials. Note: Your home screen may look slightly different based on your plan. 2. Go to settings 3. Go to HealthSafe ID Settings 4. Manage settings 5. Change password 6. Update email 7.
